name: Dr. Rohan Jotwani
title: Co-Director
bio: Rohan Jotwani MD, MBA is a board-certified Anesthesiologist and Pain Medicine specialist. Dr. Jotwani completed his residency in Anesthesiology across three hospitals: New York Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center, Hospital for Special Surgery and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, where he also served as chief resident. He went on to finish his training by completing an Interventional Pain Medicine fellowship at Harvard Medical School/the Brigham and Women’s Hospital. Dr. Jotwani’s research involves looking at extended reality approaches to train the next generation of physicians and improve precision interventional procedures through XR planning. He currently serves as the co-director of the Extended Reality Anesthesia Immersion Lab (XRAIL) and is a founding member of the American Medical Extended Reality Association.
